name: jj-palette
description: Jujutsu commands in the Command Palette: describe, commit, diff, edit and user-defined commands.

jjPalette.editor.description: Value of JJ_EDITOR for commands that open a message editor (describe, commit, and custom commands with mode "editor"). Must block until the message tab is closed (e.g. 'code --wait', 'code-insiders --wait', 'codium --wait'). Empty string keeps the editor from the jj config / environment.

jjPalette.diffArgs.description: Arguments appended to 'jj diff'. '--git' produces a unified diff that is syntax-highlighted in the editor tab. Examples: ["--git", "-r", "@-"], ["--stat"].

jjPalette.changeRevset.description: Revset listing the changes offered by 'jj edit' and by ${revision} in custom commands.

jjPalette.customCommands.description: Custom jj commands. Commands in the user settings also get their own Command Palette entry ("jj <name>") after a window reload. The picker "jj custom..." lists commands from user, workspace and folder settings; a later scope replaces an entry of the same name. Add entries here or with "jj add custom command...".

name.description: Name shown in the picker. Also usable as the argument of a keybinding.

args.description: Arguments passed to jj, as a string ("log -r @- --limit 5") or an array (["log", "-r", "@-"]). A leading "jj" is ignored. ${revision} opens a change picker; ${input} asks for a value.

enumDescriptions: Run in the background. Short output is shown as a notification, long output in an editor tab.
Run in the background. Output always opens in an editor tab.
Run as a task with JJ_EDITOR set, so jj opens its message editor as a VS Code tab (like describe and commit).
Run visibly in the terminal panel. Use for interactive commands.

language.description: Language id for the output tab in modes "auto" and "document" (for example "diff"). Default: plain text.

jjPalette.adhocMode.description: How 'jj custom...' > 'Run with arguments...' shows its result.

jjPalette.timeoutSeconds.description: Time limit for background jj commands (diff, edit, custom commands in modes "auto" and "document").

jjPalette.refreshJjx.description: After a command finishes, ask the Jujutsu X extension (if installed) to refresh its graph.
